narr: A frontal boundary moved into the region and stalled while Tropical Storm Rafael meandered in the gulf. Moisture from the decaying tropical cyclone streamed north across Louisiana. This produced heavy rain over the area that produced flooding.
ev: KLFY and a local fire department reported multiple streets flooded around Lafayette. Several vehicles were flooded along Ambassador Caffery Parkway. At least one home in Youngsville also flloded.
The Allen Parish Sherriff's Office reported water over Highways 112, 462, 112, 10, and 165. Multiple homes were flooded in Oakdale with ankle deep water at the height of the event.
A stream gage went above flood stage during a heavy rain event in Port Barre. The overflowing ditch flooded a nearby street.

Numerous streets and highways were flooded across Alexandria, Pineville, Ball, Union Hill, and Deville with some impassable. Some vehicles stalled in the floodwaters. Multiple structures had water approach, but no homes took in water. Rainfall totals exceeded 8 inches.
The Avoyelles Parish EM reported Highway 114 and 115 was flooded around Hessmer and Marksville. Roads from Marksville to Deville were also flooded.
